SELECT 
  CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS order_date_helsinki,
  o.status,
  COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM fact_web_order o
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
GROUP BY order_date_helsinki, o.status
ORDER BY o.status
